senses.gloss: m. (קרר to roll, drag; cmp. גָּרַר II) wagon-driver (dialect. interch. with קַדָּר fr. קדר, cmp. כַּדּוּר a. גַּנְדַּר I).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 4:14">Kidd. IV, 14</cite> (<cite ref="Kiddushin 82a:2-8">82ᵃ</cite>) <he>לא ילמד … חמר גמל קדר ספן וכ׳</he> Bab. ed. (Mish. <he>ספר</he> for <cite ref="S00168"><he>קדר</he></cite>; Y. ed. <he>ספר</he> a. <he>ק׳</he>) no man should train his son to be an ass-driver, a camel-leader, wagoner, sailor, shepherd, or tavern-keeper; <cite ref="Tractate Soferim 15:10">Treat. Sof’rim XV, 10</cite>; Y. Kidd. IV, 66ᶜ <he>קרר קדר</he> (strike out either).

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 6:1">B. Mets. VI, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Metzia 75b:15">75ᵇ</cite>) <he>שכר את החמר ואת הקדר וכ׳</he> (Ms. R. 1 <he>הקרד</he>, corr. acc.) if one hires an ass-driver or a wagoner &c.

<cite ref="Tosefta Keilim Batra 1:13">Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. I, 13</cite> <he>ישיבת הקארר וקושרה</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>הקרר</he>; R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 22:9">Kel. XXII, 9</cite> <he>הקרון וקישרה</he>) the driver’s seat when he has tied it (to the wagon).—Pl. <he>קָרָרִים</he>, <he>קָרָרִין</he> (<he>קַדָּ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Kamma 3:4">B. Kam. III, 4</cite> <he>שני קד׳</he> (<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 2:9">Tosef. ib. II, 9</cite> <he>חַמָּרִין</he>).
